name: Samar Abbas
headline: AI | NLP | Generative AI | Data Analysis
tagline: Advancing reliable language intelligence through research, teaching and real-world AI applications.
summary: Research-focused academic and AI professional with experience in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI and intelligent systems development. Research assistant experience at Xi'an Jiaotong University (2019–2024), academic teaching and department leadership roles, published research in international journals and conferences, and practical work on RAG-based question answering, LLM chatbots and data-driven applications.
